info.description: Inventory Movements & Stock – Transactional and master data in SAP S4H for tracking material movements and stock levels. Includes material document headers with posting dates and transaction types (MKPF), material document line items with movement types, quantities and values (MSEG), plant-level material master data with MRP and procurement parameters (MARC), and storage-location-level stock quantities (MARD). Core to the Inventory Management (MM-IM) subprocess within Plan-to-Fulfill.
